body.name: input-determined recursive task and agenda compiler
body.construction:
An unfinished task is a tuple
\[
 \tau=(G_\tau,q_\tau,Y_\tau,X_\tau,s_\tau,\mathscr L_\tau),
\]
where \(G_\tau\) is the current induced CADMG on the active random mask \(R_\tau\), \(q_\tau\) is its context-labelled rational kernel, \(Y_\tau\subseteq R_\tau\), \(X_\tau\subseteq R_\tau\setminus Y_\tau\), \(s_\tau\in H\) is its supplied context label, and \(\mathscr L_\tau\) is the inherited positivity ledger. The input-determined compiler initializes
\[
 q_s(v)=\frac{p_H(v,s)}{\sum_{v':(v',s)\in\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^+)}p_H(v',s)}
 \qquad(s\in H)
\]
and scans the stored normalized syntax in the fixed topological, context, vertex, and row order. Its gate agenda contains exactly the selector-gate occurrences actually present in these initialized kernels. It never contains an operation token whose graphical predicate has not yet been evaluated.

After the gate agenda is empty, the compiler selects the least unfinished task in the same fixed input order and applies the following recursion. First it closes an empty-intervention terminal task by the required marginalization. Second it replaces the task by its restriction to the ancestors of \(Y_\tau\) whenever that ancestor set is proper, and it performs the ordinary intervention augmentation by removing from the active mask every vertex that is a nonancestor of \(Y_\tau\) after deleting incoming arrows to \(X_\tau\). Third it computes the districts of the current postintervention graph and, when there is more than one, replaces the parent by the canonically ordered proper-district child tasks. Fourth, in the one-district case, it computes the unique district required by the recursive identification case. If that district lies in a proper ambient district, the compiler fixes exactly the prescribed complement, in the lexicographically least valid fixing sequence contained in that complement, and regenerates the successor task. Each step of this sequence computes its margin from the current labelled kernel by
\[
 K_j=\frac{N_j}{D_j},\qquad
 m_j=\sum_{x_{W_j}}K_j
     =\frac{\sum_{x_{W_j}}N_j}{D_j},
\]
reduces this displayed fraction, and records its numerator as the indicated nonempty sum and its denominator as the already registered positive product. If the district itself is an ambient district, the compiler records the corresponding terminal district factor. It emits a residual token exactly in the recursive terminal/failure case in which the gate scan is empty, neither nonancestor predicate holds, the postintervention graph has one district, and no proper ambient district supplies the prescribed fixing recursion. Thus residual readiness is the conjunction of failures of explicit finite graphical predicates, independently of whether any residual verifier candidate passes.
